+    _TTY_MACRO = re.compile(
+        r'(?<!\w)(?:'
+        r'(?P<hr>HORIZONTALLINE)(?!\w)'
+        r'|(?P<single>[IBMUC])\((?P<value>[^()]+)\)'
+        r'|(?P<pair>[LR])\((?P<label>[^(),]+),\s*(?P<target>[^()]+)\)'
+        r')'
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        """Render documentation markup for terminal output."""
+        def render(match):
+            if match.group('hr'):
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+
+            macro = match.group('single') or match.group('pair')
+            if macro == 'I' or macro == 'C':
+                return "`%s'" % match.group('value')
+            if macro == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % match.group('value')
+            if macro == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % match.group('value')
+            if macro == 'U':
+                return match.group('value')
+            if macro == 'L':
+                return '%s <%s>' % (match.group('label').strip(), match.group('target').strip())
+            return match.group('label').strip()  # R(text,reference)
+
+        return cls._TTY_MACRO.sub(render, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):

+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocCLI(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_tty_ify_existing_macros(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify("I(italic) B(bold) M(module) U(url) C(constant)"),
+            "`italic' *bold* [module] url `constant'",
+        )
+
+    def test_tty_ify_link_and_reference(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify("L(text,url)"), "text <url>")
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify("L(text, url)"), "text <url>")
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify("R(text,reference)"), "text")
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify("R(text, reference)"), "text")
+
+    def test_tty_ify_horizontal_line(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify("HORIZONTALLINE"), "\n-------------\n")
+
+    def test_tty_ify_multiple_macros(self):
+        text = "before M(name)B(text)C(value)R(text,ref) after"
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), "before [name]*text*`value'text after")
+
+    def test_tty_ify_preserves_non_macro_parentheses(self):
+        text = "IBM(International Business Machines) X(value)"
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), text)
